title: Code and build evidence for: A cross-edition panel of chemical limits in China's food safety standards
description: Curated code-and-evidence archive for the Data Descriptor and its dataset (figshare, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.33005717): extraction, cross-edition alignment, release assembly, English-label linkage, tests and the validation suite behind 46,337 limit records from five mandatory Chinese food-safety standard families (2002-2026). Source standards are not redistributed; per-word OCR dumps are withheld from the archive and pinned by sha256 in the completion manifest.
